why: Built 23 Sep 2026 after Joana found a TRIS notification (Spain 2026/0266/ES, the textile and footwear decree) that Brubru had not seen. The source list for a client must not be drawn only from our side: every source the client reads, or that bears on their remit, is listed here with a freshness test, and anything we do not ingest is listed as a gap rather than left out.

sources.name: TRIS: national draft technical rules (Directive (EU) 2015/1535)
sources.why: Member States notify draft rules on textiles, packaging, waste and labelling here before adoption; the standstill is the window to react.

sources.name: WTO technical barriers to trade (TBT) notifications
sources.why: Third-country technical rules affecting EU textile and product exporters.

sources.name: JRC Product Bureau (ESPR methodology consultation, textile preparatory study)
sources.sql: SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM economy_items WHERE body_code = 'dpp' AND guid LIKE 'jrc-pb-%'
sources.why: The methodological reports and the textile study are drafted here before any delegated act.

sources.name: Commission Have Your Say consultations
sources.sql: SELECT max(scraped_at) FROM public_consultations WHERE source = 'commission'
sources.why: Feedback windows on ESPR delegated acts, including the apparel-textiles act (initiative 16116).

sources.name: Expert groups register: group LIST only (not the Ecodesign Forum's meetings)
sources.sql: SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM economy_items WHERE item_type = 'expert_group'
sources.why: Proves the register's group list is re-read. It says NOTHING about Forum meetings or documents (5 Oct 2026: a client brief claimed 49 days 'stale' on this, about the wrong thing). Meetings are read live by dpp_watch (forum_register row).

sources.name: EU legal corpus (Cellar)
sources.why: Full text of the acts the DPP connector quotes.

sources.name: Commission DPP news and events (DPP corpus)
sources.sql: SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM economy_items WHERE body_code = 'dpp' AND item_type IN ('news','event') AND guid NOT LIKE 'jrc-pb-%'
sources.why: Registry and passport announcements and webinars.

sources.name: ECHA news and ECHA Weekly
sources.sql: SELECT greatest((SELECT max(document_date)::date FROM economy_items WHERE body_code = 'echa' AND item_type IN ('news','press_release')), (SELECT max(news_date)::date FROM eu_news_items WHERE institution = 'ECHA'))
sources.why: Substances of concern: an ESPR information requirement and a textile issue.
sources.cadence_note: 28 Sep 2026: ECHA publishes a news release about monthly (9 Jun, 17 Jun, 17 Aug, 24 Sep 2026) and the ECHA Weekly every week; the old check read news alone at 14 days and called a normal five-week gap STALE while the Weekly was current.

sources.name: European Environment Agency news, editorials, briefings and reports
sources.sql: SELECT max(document_date) FROM economy_items WHERE body_code = 'eea' AND item_type IN ('news','press_release','publication')
sources.why: Textile waste and circularity evidence. Briefings and reports are where EEA publishes its analysis; news alone went quiet from 14 Sep 2026 while a production-and-consumption briefing came out on 22 Sep (ledger widened 1 Oct 2026).

sources.name: CINEA (LIFE programme, funds DPP-TEX)
sources.sql: SELECT max(document_date) FROM economy_items WHERE body_code = 'cinea' AND item_type IN ('news','press_release')

sources.name: BOE (Spanish official gazette): textile, footwear, ecodesign, passport, EPR, waste, environment
sources.sql: SELECT max(finished_at) FROM sync_runs WHERE source_key = 'official_gazettes_boe' AND status = 'success'
sources.why: Where the Spanish textile and footwear Royal Decree will be published once adopted. Ingested from 8 Oct 2026 through the BOE open-data daily summary (Mon to Sat). Freshness here is the last SUCCESSFUL READ of the gazette (the table holds only matching items, so the newest item says nothing about whether it was read); the daily sync fails on a window it read nothing from, so a success cannot be vacuous.

sources.name: DOGC (Catalan official gazette, section-1 norms): laws, decrees, orders on the remit
sources.sql: SELECT max(finished_at) FROM sync_runs WHERE source_key = 'official_gazettes_dogc' AND status = 'success'
sources.why: Catalan waste and circular-economy rules, Terraqui's home ground. Ingested from 8 Oct 2026 from the Generalitat open-data dataset 'Normativa del DOGC' (laws, decrees and orders of section 1 only: ~0.5 norms a day, a matching one a few times a year). Freshness here is the last SUCCESSFUL READ of the gazette (the table holds only matching items, so the newest item says nothing about whether it was read); the daily sync fails on a window it read nothing from, so a success cannot be vacuous. Anything published in other DOGC sections (resolutions, announcements) is NOT covered.

sources.name: CEN-CENELEC JTC 24 (DPP standards committee) drafts
sources.why: Draft DPP standards before publication. Not ingested and not ingestible by us: drafts sit behind national standards body membership (checked 8 Oct 2026, no open feed); only the six published EN standards are in the corpus. The one public signal is a prEN entering CEN's public enquiry or formal vote, which is listed on a JavaScript application with no API. Remains a documented gap, not a quiet source.

sources.name: Ecodesign Forum meeting DOCUMENTS: CircaBC folder with draft measures (agendas, minutes, slides ARE read live)
sources.why: PARTLY read since 8 Oct 2026: dpp_watch lists the agenda, minutes and presentations the expert-groups register itself publishes for each Forum meeting (public download links on the meeting record; checked on meetings 76062 and 69322). NOT read: the CircaBC folder linked from the register, where draft measures and working documents sit. A quiet meeting list does not mean quiet documents; a meeting with no published document is reported as 'none published'.
